public_body: Southfield Redevelopment Authority Board Of Directors
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board was not required to name the parcel for its Purpose 6 executive session because disclosure would harm its negotiating position. The attorney conflict allegation was declined as outside the OML.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board entered executive session on November 6 without disclosing the parcel of property to be discussed.
allegations.key_passage: after questioning the Board's counsel, we are satisfied that the Board has met its burden of demonstrating that publicly disclosing the specific parcel that was discussed during the November 6 executive session would have been detrimental to the Board's negotiating position.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board's attorney may have a conflict of interest because he also serves as land use attorney for another town.
allegations.key_passage: We note that, even if true, this allegation would not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.
